name: Social Networks Benchmark Dataset for Diseases Classification
description: A dataset and benchmark for classifying diseases or health-related outcomes using social network data and features.
reputation: A niche academic dataset from 2016 that sees limited but recurring use in social-epidemiology and network-analysis research.
notes: Potential class imbalance and relatively small sample sizes; privacy and demographic bias concerns; non-LLM / graph-feature-based benchmark; dataset is somewhat dated (2016).
